evidence.sourceTitle: PDEGym / Poseidon (Time-Dependent Data) official release documentation
evidence.locator: Datasets: identifier mapping; BaseTimeDataset; NS-Sines data card
evidence.statement: The official release maps named dynamic PDE datasets to download and temporal loaders. The NS-Sines card explicitly documents 20,000 trajectories with 21 uniformly sampled time steps and train/validation/test splits. The admitted collection is restricted to time-dependent systems.
